name: Fluximmo
positioning: French property listings as an API — the raw feed behind pige tools and market products.
description: Fluximmo collects real estate listings published across French portals and classified sites, deduplicates them, distinguishes private from professional sellers, and delivers the result as a structured API with history and change tracking.
real_estate_use: It is infrastructure rather than an end-user product: a pige tool, a market study or an internal prospecting system uses the feed instead of scraping portals themselves. The deduplication and private-versus-professional classification are the hard parts, since the same property appears repeatedly under different descriptions and prices.
features: Aggregated listing feed across French portals and classified sites
Deduplication of the same property across sources
Price change and listing lifecycle history
REST API delivery with historical access

use_cases.job: Build a prospecting or market product on a listing feed instead of scraping portals
Feed an internal canvassing system with deduplicated private-seller listings
